image_description: A close-up photograph of a green snake, likely a green mamba, resting among green foliage. The snake's head is prominent in the foreground, displaying a yellowish-green hue that transitions to a brighter emerald green along the body. The scales appear smooth and glossy. The eye is dark and round. The background consists of blurred green leaves, suggesting an arboreal environment.
